title: Payroll Assistant
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Payroll Assistant with a payroll bureau in south Fife. You will already have gained payroll experience covering payroll processing and compliance procedures including auto enrolment pension, particularly in Sage Payroll.

This is a challenging role and you will deal with preparing clients BACS payments for EEs, 3rd Party and HMRC payments.
You will be managing any payroll queries via telephone and email, providing excellent customer service for clients and their EEs.
You will be updating client payroll manuals as required.
You will be diligent and compliant with record keeping and GDPR.
You will process Year End and uploading P60s to EEs accounts, process new starts & leavers, issue P45s, process SMP, SSP, SPP and ensure PAE.
You will complete Payroll year end and issue P60s, monitor employees holidays, sickness and time keeping.
Reconcile bank accounts, post receipts and allocate to customer accounts.

There is an opportunity to gain further experience in accounts as well, if you wish to do so, but only if you want.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
The role of Sales Administrator in Fife involves managing administrative tasks to support the retail team and ensure the smooth running of sales processes. You'll play a key part in keeping things organised, assisting with customer orders, and maintaining accurate records.

Client Details

An organisation in the retail industry based in Fife.

Description

- Support the sales team by preparing relevant documentation and reports.
- Maintain and update customer records in the system.
- Handle customer enquiries and provide timely responses.
- Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth order fulfilment.
- Monitor stock levels and assist with inventory management tasks.
- Assist in the preparation of sales presentations and materials.
- Contribute to general administrative duties as required.

Profile

A successful Sales Administrator should have:
- Strong organisational and administrative skills.
- Attention to detail for accurate data entry and record-keeping.
- Good communication skills for handling customer interactions.
- Proficiency in office software and systems.
- A proactive approach to supporting the sales team.

- Permanent contract in Fife.
- Salary ranging from 27,000 to 33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Opportunities to work within the retail industry.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Accountant
company: First Military Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accountant
Location: Kirkcaldy
Salary: £38000 to £45000 Pro Rata DOE
Hours: 25 hours per week with flexibility
Job Overview
At D Hall Renewables Ltd, we deliver safe, reliable wind energy projects worldwide. Following a period of continued growth, we are now looking for a motivated Part Time Accountant to join our dynamic financial team based out of our Fife office!
This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the financial health of our organisation through precise accounting practices and effective financial management.
As a key player in our finance department, you will manage and support the current financial function, ensuring accuracy and compliance in a fast-paced environment. This position is perfect for motivated individuals looking to apply their accounting skills in a flexible, part-time (25 hours) capacity that makes a real impact.
Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain accurate financial records using Xero and Dext accounting software.
- Process accounts payable and receivable transactions efficiently, assisting with making timely payments, as well as collating, processing, approving invoices.
- Support the payroll function during busy periods and holidays.
- Assist with financial reporting, including preparing statements and reconciling accounts to ensure data integrity.
- Support month-end and year-end closing activities by verifying balances and preparing necessary documentation.
- Collaborate with team members on financial projects, providing mentorship and guidance.
- Maintain compliance with organizational policies and regulatory standards related to financial accounting.
- Contribute to the ongoing improvement of financial processes and systems for better efficiency.

Experience
- Proven accountancy experience.
- Proven experience working with Xero accounting software as well as Dext.
- Significant experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger activities.
- Knowledge of financial management principles and practices within a professional setting.
- Excellent attention to detail with the ability to analyse financial data accurately.
- Demonstrated ability to mentor or support colleagues in accounting is essential.

In return, we offer:
- £38000 to £45000 Pro Rata DOE
- 25 hours per week with flexibility
- Office based with some flexibility to work from home
- Private Medical Insurance
- Free on-site parking
- Cycle to work scheme
- Casual Dress

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Anderson Knight Recruitment is working on behalf of a well-established and reputable organisation within the FMCG sector to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join their finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts experience who is looking to develop their career within a fast-paced and dynamic business. The role will support the wider finance function across a range of transactional and month-end activities, ensuring the smooth running of financial operations within a high-volume environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing high volumes of purchase and sales invoices accurately and in a timely manner
- Performing bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of VAT returns
- Supporting accounts payable and accounts receivable functions, ensuring timely processing of payments and receipts
- Maintaining supplier records and resolving invoice and payment queries
- Processing employee expenses and company credit card transactions
- Assisting with month-end processes, including journals, accruals, prepayments, and reporting schedules
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating discrepancies
- Liaising with internal departments and external suppliers to resolve finance queries efficiently
- Providing general administrative support to the finance team as required

Requirements:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Experience with VAT, reconciliations, and transactional finance processes
- Strong Excel skills and familiarity with accounting systems
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Ability to manage a busy workload and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to work
- Desirable: Previous experience within the FMCG, manufacturing, or distribution sector

What s On Offer:
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Opportunity to join a well-established and growing FMCG business
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities
- Stable, long-term career prospects within a successful organisation

This role would suit an Accounts Assistant looking to build on their existing experience within a reputable FMCG organisation. If you would like to be considered, please apply via the link below.
